title: 'Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Fourth Promo for "Assassin" Arc
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Miraijin A 's Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru: Jakushou Ryouchi wo Uketsuida node, Yuushuu na Jinzai wo Fuyashiteitara, Saikyou Ryouchi ni Natteta ( As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World ) light novel revealed…
author: MyAnimeList

title: 4-Piece Band Subway Daydream Disbands
content: Four-piece rock band Subway Daydream has announced its disbandment on Sunday. The band had been on hiatus since January, due to a member's poor health. The band had been discussing about resuming their musical activities, but decided to disband due to the members' differences in the direction of their future…
author: ANN

title: Shōzen TV Anime Unveils New Trailer, Key Visual, Cast
content: The staff for Shōzen , the television anime adaptation of Jiang Jia Meizi 's Chinese manhua Shang Shan , revealed a new trailer, key visual, and another cast member on Sunday. Kana Hanazawa plays Ko Kuka, Dōzen's childhood friend who shares a special bond with him.
author: ANN

title: 'Hidan no Aria Corto' Reveals Main Staff, New Cast, April 2027 Premiere
content: The MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival 2026 event revealed the main staff, new cast, and a key visual (pictured) for Hiden no Aria Corto ( Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto ) on Sunday. The short anime adapting Chuugaku Akamatsu 's action comedy light novel will stream on various platforms beginning in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Aria the Scarlet Ammo Short Anime Unveils Title, New & Returning Cast, April 2027 Debut
content: Kadokawa revealed on Sunday the key visual, returning and new cast members, main staff, and April 2027 streaming debut for Hidan no Aria Corto ( Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto ), the new short anime commemorating the 15th anniversary of the Aria the Scarlet Ammo anime series.
author: ANN

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Anime's 2nd Part Casts Shinichirō Miki
content: The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira 's Mission: Yozakura Family ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) manga announced on Sunday Shinichirō Miki will join the cast of the second part of the second season in episode 47, which airs on November 29.
author: ANN

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Visual
content: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 revealed a new trailer and visual. The announcements were made at the MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival 2026 event. Season 2 is currently airing and is available to watch on Crunchyroll and Muse Asia. Studio ENGI returns to animate the sequel with Manabu Kurihara as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Detective is Already Dead Anime's 2nd Season Reveals Trailer, Visual for New Arc
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on nigozyu and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series revealed a new visual and promotional video on Sunday for the show's new arc.
author: ANN

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table Anime Announces Sequel
content: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table anime is getting a sequel. An ultra teaser visual was also released. The announcement was made at the MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival 2026 event. Studio DEEN animated the first season and movie and they both star Chiyuki Miura as Yuki.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.' Sequel Anime in Production
content: The MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival 2026 event announced on Sunday that a sequel for the Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu. ( Shiboyugi: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table ) anime series is in production, revealing an "ultra" teaser visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList
